summary.text: Bill Rabon is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 8 since January 2011 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Bill Rabon, whose full name is William Rabon, graduated from West Columbus High School in 1969, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University and a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine from the University of Georgia in 1976, and he is a partner in multiple animal hospitals.
He is vice chair of the Brunswick Community College Board of Trustees.
Rabon assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2011.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Appropriations on Department of Transportation, Rules and Operations of the Senate and Transportation committees and as a member of the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment, Appropriations/Base Budget and Finance committees.
